'''Scopique''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], who trained at [[Darth Scabrous]]'s [[Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]]. He was also known to have owned a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] during his time at the academy.

==Personality and traits==
Scopique was scheming, and willing to use anyone to his advantage. Despite this, he's also suspicious about [[Darth Scabrous]]' activity, such as kidnapping other Sith Acolytes.

==Powers and abilities==
Scopique was able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to disable [[Mannock T'sank]], a much larger Acolyte at the Sith Academy where he trained.
